source_status: All six historical pulse runs are development data. The signed 30 mm pair was already inspected before this audit; no untouched driven validation is claimed.
input_source: Direct MCU sampled governor acceleration. This is a commanded input, not measured physical acceleration.
selection: All original canonical valid rows/segments preserved. No new residual-based interval selection or parameter fit.
initialization: Short: original causal seven-point quadratic and causal frozen-ODE history<=0.20s retaining current raw angle. Continuous: first0.1s or0.5s fixed-ODE initial-state fit, raw endpoint angle retained; all later points scored with no measurement correction. Only initial state is estimated, never model/input coefficients.
assumptions: Unit acceleration-servo gain and zero physical input delay
Frozen batch6 local encoder phase applied to older pulse sessions; it is not a global angle calibration
Recorded future governor input is supplied for conditional replay, not forecast before commands exist
Camera scale and lag frozen from historical four-training-run analysis; no independent physical scale or exposure timing
Equivalent rod mass/inertia, cart mass/drag and motor force limits are not identified by these data

optical_map.method: Mean best-lag scale and median best lag from preserved four-training-run analysis; only each run pre-pulse pixel baseline is new.

numerical_verification.solver: DOP853 rtol2e-9 atol1e-11 maxstep1ms; initial-state fitting maxstep5ms, least_squares maxnfev50 diff_step1e-4, convergence required

original_admission.time_basis: board acquisition snapshot proxy; sensor/input latency not independently calibrated
original_admission.rate_channel: omitted: filtered omega has unknown effective delay

kinematics.interpretation: Internal sampled-command/count kinematics only. Position is emitted step count and velocity/acceleration are governor state; none is independent physical cart measurement.

timing_proxy.caveat: Board acquisition snapshot to host receipt proxy. Slope includes receipt jitter/trend; intercept includes unmeasured transport. Camera t is host-read, not exposure time.

camera.source: raw vision.pivot_px only; mirrored/fused fields ignored

shape.lag_definition: Compare pivot_x(t) with counted_x(t-lag); positive lag means camera pixels trail the receipt-mapped count. Same-run fitted, not calibrated latency.

optical_frozen_training_map.origin_method: per-run pre-pulse median; counted pre-pulse origin is zero
